questions.question: Why did the author speciﬁcally mention that his fear of water originated at the age of three at California beach?
options: To exaggerate the intensity of the sea waves
To dramatize the story’s opening
To trace the root of his phobia and highlight its persistence
To criticize his father's careless behavior

questions.question: The author says, “Terror had me in its grip... My legs paralyzed, rigid with fear.” This is an example of:
options: Hyperbole and metaphor
Personiﬁcation and sensory imagery
Simile and irony
Alliteration and satire

questions.question: Which of the following best captures the central message of Deep Water?
options: Fear is a natural instinct and must be avoided.
Real courage is the ability to move forward in spite of fear.
Adults must supervise children near water.
Past trauma always haunts a person.

questions.question: Douglas mentions Roosevelt’s quote: "All we have to fear is fear itself." What purpose does this serve in the narrative?
options: To introduce political ideology
To justify irrational panic
To emphasize that fear is more dangerous than the object feared
To connect historical context to his swimming lessons

questions.question: Why does the author feel “released, free to walk the trails and climb the peaks”?
options: Because he had ﬁnally gone on a nature hike
Because he had overcome his fear of heights
Because conquering his fear of water had mentally liberated him
Because he left his job and retired to the mountains

questions.question: The author's use of short, fragmented sentences like “I was suﬀocating. I tried to yell…” serves to:
options: Create a humorous tone
Slow the pace of the narrative
Mimic the panicked rhythm of his thoughts
Provide factual information

questions.question: The resolution of the story, when Douglas ﬁnally swims across the Warm Lake, symbolizes:
options: Revenge against the childhood bully
The start of his career in public service
Triumph over irrational fear and full recovery
The end of his swimming lessons

questions.question: What role does the swimming instructor play in the narrative structure of Deep Water?
options: He introduces conﬂict into the story
He serves as the antagonist
He is the mentor ﬁgure helping the protagonist overcome internal struggle
